memory_update.text: POWL should be tracked as a direct electrical-equipment discovery candidate for AI data-center power-chain exposure; key evidence is the May 2026 >$400M data-center order and medium-voltage switchgear positioning.
IESC should be tracked as an underfollowed execution/labor/electrical-infrastructure candidate despite large-cap size; fiscal Q1 2026 segment growth ties directly to data-center demand.
NVT should be tracked as a large-cap but relatively under-discussed liquid-cooling and rack-level power infrastructure platform; next layer must verify revenue purity and order conversion.

The node appears to be splitting into at least four investable subnodes: integrated power/cooling OEMs, medium-voltage switchgear/electrical equipment, electrical/communications construction labor, and liquid-cooling/rack-level components.

Need a later Layer 1C/2 search for smaller US-listed suppliers below USD 10B in transformer parts, busbars, cable assemblies, controls/sensors, grid analytics, permitting software, surety/insurance and regional electrical contractors; this pass found few clean public names in the preferred USD 300M-10B range with strong evidence.

node: AI data-center power chain: electrical equipment, cooling, grid interconnection and construction services
summary: Layer 1B expansion identifies a two-lane universe for the AI data-center power-chain node. Reference lane: Vertiv remains the obvious high-attention benchmark for complete power, cooling and modular AI-factory infrastructure. Underfollowed/discovery lane: Powell Industries, IES Holdings and nVent have more direct chokepoint exposure than their generic industrial labels imply: medium-voltage switchgear and behind-the-meter data-center electrical systems; communications/electrical infrastructure and custom engineered solutions for data centers; and liquid-cooling plus rack-level power distribution. The strongest near-term evidence is Powell's disclosed >$400M data-center order and IES's reported data-center-driven segment growth. nVent is included as a large-cap but unusually pure second-order liquid-cooling/power component platform. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
